mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recruit_user (student_id, user_name, introduction, major, college, first_intention, second_intention, phone, gender) VALUES (#{student_id}, #{user_name}, #{introduction}, #{major}, #{college}, #{first_intention}, #{second_intention}, #{phone}, #{gender}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_name = user_name, introduction = introduction, major = major, college = college, first_intention = first_intention, second_intention = second_intention, phone = phone, gender = gender;

INSERT INTO volunteer (id, volunteer_department,level) SELECT #{id}, (SELECT department_id FROM department WHERE department_name = #{departmentName1}),1 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM volunteer WHERE id=#{id})

INSERT INTO volunteer (id, volunteer_department,level) SELECT #{id}, (SELECT department_id FROM department WHERE department_name = #{departmentName2}),2 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM volunteer WHERE id=#{id})

INSERT INTO status (id, department_id, status, MessageStatus) VALUES (#{id}, (select department_id from department where department_name = #{departmentName1}), 0, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE department_id = department_id, status = 0, MessageStatus = 0;
